explanations.8: The regex replaces leading and trailing slashes, so '/docs/intro/' becomes 'docs/intro' — the ?? at the end provides an empty string fallback if permalink is missing.
explanations.13: We keep voted as null initially so that the server and browser render the same HTML at first, preventing React from complaining about mismatches — localStorage only exists in the browser, not on the server.
explanations.22: This eslint comment tells React 'ignore the rule against setState in effects here' because we intentionally do this once to sync with localStorage after the page loads.
explanations.30: If the response status is OK, parse it as JSON; otherwise return null to skip the data update.
explanations.60: useCallback dependencies include slug, apiUrl, and storageKey — if any of these change, the function gets redefined so it always uses the latest values.
